_comment: The dev board's asset pipelines (tools/devboard/README.md, DESIGN 4.120). runs: 'board' (its steps run on the board) or 'handoff' (a button writes the task for Claude and sends it through Send to Claude). A hand-off pipeline becomes a board pipeline once its steps are written into the docs: give it 'steps' and 'doc', and the page shows them with no new page code.

pipelines.name: Paintings importer
pipelines.doc: docs/HANDOFF.md, The pipeline; the header of scripts/importSprites.mjs
pipelines.for: A painting (a generator's image, a sheet of the user's paintings) becomes the sprite of the same name.
steps: Drop the painting on the card: it is saved into inspirations/<folder>/ (PNG, never overwriting).
Pick its island on the sheet (the importer's --islands, drawn over the painting); raise 'white' to about 200 to key out a light-grey shadow or grid paper.
Fill its art/sources.json entry: footprint, targetHeight from the yardstick, anchor 'centre', flip if fronted on the left, shift for a small object.

Import: npm run art -- --check writes public/art/sprites, the packed sheet in public/art/sheets, sprites.json and the check sheet shots/import_check.png (commit the sprites, the sheet and the manifest).
Judge it by eye beside the code sprite and the citizen; then mark it checked.

pipelines.name: Tripo Studio
pipelines.for: An image made from the prompt in Tripo Studio (Image tab), then brought in through the paintings importer.
pipelines.task: Make the art for this sprite with the Tripo Studio pipeline, using the prompt below. The pipeline is not written into EdaBuilder's docs yet: work it out with me (what I generate in Tripo Studio, how the images come to you, any steps before the paintings importer), run it for this sprite, and write the pipeline into docs/HANDOFF.md as a numbered list so the dev board can run it next time (tools/devboard/pipelines.json).

pipelines.name: Aseprite
pipelines.for: A sprite drawn or redrawn in Aseprite (headless with --batch and Lua scripts, or by hand), at the game's pixel size.
pipelines.task: Make the art for this sprite with the Aseprite pipeline, using the prompt below as the brief. The pipeline is not written into EdaBuilder's docs yet: work it out with me (trace, redraw, export, install, as in my Azyrion Tamer project's tools/aseprite/redraw.py if it fits), show me every sprite at 8x before it goes into the game, and write the pipeline into docs/HANDOFF.md as a numbered list so the dev board can run it next time (tools/devboard/pipelines.json).
